KUNINGRIIGID GODOT AUTOPORT — V0.88 HIDDEN 3D RENDERERS SLEEP
Reason: Both 3D Godot SubViewports stop continuous GPU redraw when the player is in a different scene, such as the economy screen, tactical battle, other map, or 2D atlas. Restoring the relevant view resumes rendering without recreating meshes, soldier rigs, map state or save data. Hidden views no longer perform per-frame render motion work.

Release requirements: version 0.88.<run>. Publish verified Windows EXE and PCK bridge/full/update bundles with SHA256 checks. Android APK only when persistently signed with previously compatible release key. Keep old saves and Windows changed-files update support.
